description: An expression after `:` or `->` stored as metadata on a function, class or module; the interpreter never enforces it.
A separate tool (mypy, pyright, ty, pyrefly) that reads the source without running it and reports type errors.
Unannotated code is `Any` to a checker, so types can be added file by file and tightened over time.
Python classes match by inheritance; `Protocol` opts into matching by shape, the way TypeScript interfaces work.
Code that reads annotation objects at runtime, such as `typing.get_type_hints`, `dataclasses` or a schema builder.
